## Measurement before code: mechanism assumption 1 (and items 2 / params) — `needs_decision`

Read at `origin/main` `e540baf887` (shallow clone). Every row below is a source reading with the line cited, plus two docblocks that record an earlier run-time measurement (#24289, #22301). End-to-end boots were **NOT MEASURED** (reason: no install or build in this container; the readings agree with each other and with the claim's premise line).

**Premise holds.** A config hook `handler: async (ctx) => …` plus `refusals` is refused before any lowering runs. `defineStack` is strict by default (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:6978`) and parses the un-lowered stack when the config module loads. `refuseUndeclaredLiteralRefusalCode` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts:268`) refuses `refusals` when the hook has no `js` body. So `os validate` (its own lowering at `validate.ts:438` runs too late), `os build`, `os dev` and `os serve` all fail at config load.

### Every path a handler-authored hook runs on

| # | Path | What runs | Is the catalogue served (does the throw reach `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`)? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `os build` artifact, handler lowers | `body` (QuickJS), because body wins over handler (`objectql/src/hook-binder.ts:414-433`) | **yes**: `body-runner.ts:538` calls `resolveHookRefusal` |
| 2 | `os build` artifact, the extractor refuses the handler (free identifier, forbidden token; default warn-and-bundle) | `handler: REF` with no body, in-process from `objectstack-runtime.HASH.mjs` (`cli/src/utils/lower-callables.ts:377-395`) | **no** |
| 3 | `os build --strict-body` | the same handler is refused at build | n/a |
| 4 | `os dev` (default compile) and `os dev --artifact` | the compiled artifact. A host config's wrap reads the dev artifact door's file (`serve.ts:3921`, `new AppPlugin(artifactBundle ?? config)`) | **yes** where it lowered; otherwise row 2 |
| 5 | `os serve CONFIG` where no artifact door composes (a host config), and every other source boot | `new AppPlugin(config)` over the config module: inline function, in-process (`serve.ts:3921`; recorded in `body-runner.ts` `withInProcessHookTitle` docblock, #24289) | **no** |
| 6 | `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack(config)`, the default boot: **the harness an app tests its hooks with** | inline function, in-process (`verify/src/harness.ts:905-913`) | **no** |
| 7 | `bootStack(config, { artifact })` | lowered body | **yes** where it lowered; otherwise row 2 |
| 8 | plugin code `ql.registerHook(event, fn, opts)` | function. `opts` carries no `refusals` (`objectql/src/engine.ts:703`) | n/a: no `Hook` record, so no catalogue can be declared |
| 9 | runtime-authored hook (metadata API, stored) | must carry a body; default body runner (`app-plugin.ts:918`) | **yes** |

**Reading.** Some paths run the handler unlowered: rows 2, 5 and 6, and row 6 is the test harness. Accepting `refusals` on a handler today would declare something those paths do not honour. A build-only reading is excluded: it would still leave rows 5 and 6.

**What the measurement adds.** Every unlowered path for a declarative hook goes through one seam. `bindAppArtifactHandlers` → `ql.bindHooks(…, { wrapHandler })` (`runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts:437`) → `withInProcessHookTitle` (`body-runner.ts:364`), the in-process wrap #24289 added so that a handler's `ctx` answers like a body's. So the unlowered paths CAN answer the catalogue through the same module. It costs two things the claim does not cover:

- **(a) A breach of the file surface.** The wrap receives only `String(hook.name)` and no i18n source, so the call site at `app-artifact-handlers.ts:437` has to pass `hook` and `options.i18n`. That is one line in a file outside the claim. Per the claim I stopped here.
- **(b) No in-process marker for host-raised errors.** `resolveHookRefusal` passes an error a host call raised through unchanged (`isHostRelayedSandboxError` / `isRelayedSandboxRefusal`, which the VM bridge sets). An in-process handler has no such mark. An engine refusal of a `ctx.api` write that the handler lets escape is just the engine's error object. Applying "an undeclared code is refused loudly" in-process without a mark would turn that relayed refusal (for example `VALIDATION_FAILED` from a nested write) into a 500 fault. Matching the body path means the wrap's `ctx` view also marks errors thrown out of `ctx.api`. This is runtime machinery (estimated 80–120 lines plus tests), not a spec contract.

### Fork 1: item 1 (accept `refusals` on a handler hook)

| Option | What | Cost |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A (recommended)** | Accept `refusals` on a hook whose `handler` is a function (literal-throw reading over `String(handler)`, which is the source the lowering peels) or a string ref. Answer the catalogue on the in-process path at the one seam: `withInProcessHookTitle` becomes the in-process context wrap that also calls the catalogue module, with the host-error mark of (b). The wire is identical to the body path, because the wrap throws the same `SandboxError(…, { code, status, userMessage })` that `resolveHookRefusal` builds. | Surface +1 file (`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`, one call site). About L/2 on top of the spec half. Every row above answers. |
| B | The same, but in-process answers declared codes only. An undeclared code or a throw with no code passes through unchanged in-process. | Smaller, with no mark. But rows 2, 5 and 6 then diverge from the deployment on the "refused loudly" half, which is the source-boot vs body divergence class that #24289 closed. |
| C | Keep refusing `refusals` on a handler hook (status quo). | Zero. The downstream keeps hand-writing untyped `js` bodies. |

### Fork 2: item 2 (several sentences under one wire code)

**Precedent search.** Validation rules (`objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE.message`) and flow `end` refusals (`flows.FLOW.refusals.NODE.message`, #22450) both key one sentence by a declared NAME. Neither has a wire code per entry, and neither has a sub-key under a code. The error-code ledger (ADR-0112) has no per-code sentence family. Nested declared sub-keys do exist (`objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.options.VALUE`), but as labels, not as a refusal sentence under a code. **No precedent fits exactly.** Candidate shapes:

- **S1 (recommended, inside ruling A):** `refusals: { VALIDATION_FAILED: { message, status?, reasons?: { plan_locked: { message } } } }`. The body throws `{ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', reason: 'plan_locked' }`. Key `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.reasons.REASON.message`, declared and counted by extract/check. An undeclared reason is refused loudly like an undeclared code (literally at save, otherwise at run). The wire code and envelope stay unchanged; the entry's own `message` stays the fallback sentence.
- S2: key the entry by a refusal name and carry the wire code as a property, `refusals: { PLAN_LOCKED: { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message } }`. This is the validation-rule and flow-`end` posture, but it re-reads ruling A's "keyed by code" and the shipped guidance "`code` is not a refusal key". That is a re-ruling, so it is the maintainer's.
- Rejected: a free-text `messageKey` (ruling A's letter D).

S1 needs `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (the `hooks` group gains `reasons`), which is outside the claim.

### Params

Ruling A names "code and params" for the envelope. The measured spelling: the body throws `{ code, params: { state: 'locked' } }`; the entry declares `params: ['state']`; a double-brace hole is allowed only over a declared param, and stays refused in a message that declares none (the docblock's widening). The render uses the flow `end` text-slot renderer (the precedent for a refusal template with holes). Today `params` does not cross the VM: `quickjs-runner.ts:369-370` serialises `code / fields / status / userMessage` only. Params also needs `translation.zod.ts`, whose `hooks` docblock says "no hole is filled, the translation replaces it whole". That sentence becomes false, and the file is outside the claim.

### Asked of the seat

1. Fork 1: A, B or C. If A, extend the surface by `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`.
2. Fork 2: S1 or S2 (S2 goes to the maintainer). With S1, extend the surface by `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, plus the `os validate` translation-target check for the new sub-key.
3. Params under the spelling above, with the same `translation.zod.ts` extension.

No code, branch push or PR from this run. The `os-dev-report` follows.

## 待裁 · #33214 · 三问(处理器钩子的拒绝目录) · 2026-11-14T14:48Z

Analysis-tier: seat default tier (the contract-review tier was not used for this analysis)
Governing text: ruling 6431311681 (#26170, letter A), quoted in the dispatch: "a hook declares its refusal catalogue — `refusals: { <code>: { message, status? } }` … the i18n extract/check gates count the declared keys; an undeclared code is refused loudly … not D (a second dictionary with free-text keys)", and "refusal envelope carries the code and params". AGENTS.md Prime Directive 10: "never advertise or demo a capability the runtime doesn't actually deliver (declared ≠ enforced)".
Protocol: yes. All three answers widen the published `Hook.refusals` accept set (`Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`).
Premise (re-check: `grep -n "refuseUndeclaredLiteralRefusalCode\|hookRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody" packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`): on main `e540baf887`, a hook written as a TypeScript `handler` that declares `refusals` is refused when the config loads. The dev's measurement is 6879027410, and its report is 6879045779 (`needs_decision`, no code, no PR).

### 一句话问题

用 TypeScript 写业务钩子的应用，拒绝用户操作时只能给英文提示。平台的多语言拒绝目录只认手写的无类型 JS 钩子；一个错误码只能挂一句话；提示句也不能带参数（例如"当前状态为 X"）。

### 问一：TS 钩子能否声明拒绝目录？

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户感受 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A（推荐）** | 接受 TS 钩子的 `refusals`。构建产物、源码启动（`os serve`）和测试工具（`bootStack`）都走同一个进程内接缝，在那里接上目录，并给宿主抛出的错误打标记，行为与沙箱路径一致 | 开发、测试、生产看到的都是同一句中文提示 | spec 车道 1 个 PR；比原认领多改 1 个文件（`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`）；约 L/2 加 spec 一半；先例 PR #22525（+1110/−25） |
| B | 同 A，但进程内只翻译已声明的码，未声明的码静默放行 | 测试和源码启动下，写错的码不报错，上线后才 500 | 比 A 小，不用打标记 |
| C | 维持现状，TS 钩子仍拒收 `refusals` | 下游继续手写无类型 JS | 0 |

业务含义：A 是"一套提示，处处一致"；B 是"测试环境放水"；C 是"让客户自己绕"。

### 问二：一个错误码下挂多句提示，用哪种形状？

- **S1（推荐）**：`refusals.VALIDATION_FAILED.reasons.plan_locked.message`。钩子抛 `{ code, reason }`；每句都事先声明，由 extract/check 计数；未声明的 reason 照样响亮拒绝；线上错误码不变。在裁决 A 之内。要改 `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`（钩子翻译组）。
- S2：按拒绝名作键，把错误码放进属性。这要改写裁决 A 的"按码作键"，属于重裁。
- 排除：自由文本 `messageKey`（裁决 A 已否的 D）。
- 先例：校验规则与流程 `end` 拒绝都是"具名一句"，但没有"码下子键"，所以没有完全对上的先例。

### 问三：提示句带参数？

- **是（推荐，与 S1 同一次续派）**：钩子抛 `{ code, params }`；目录声明 `params: ['state']`；只有已声明的参数才能用 `{{ }}` 占位，没声明参数的句子照旧拒收占位。渲染复用流程 `end` 的文本槽渲染器，QuickJS 通道补上 `params`。裁决 A 已写"code and params"。
- 暂缓：先只做问一、问二。

os-decision-facets
① Long-term soundness: A + S1 + params implements the catalogue ruling A already set out, across every path. No special case is added: today's "body only" exception goes away.
② Real business pull: a downstream app (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#51) refuses in English under zh-CN today, with five distinct refusals in one hook.
③ Preventing AI mistakes: every sentence is declared and counted; an undeclared code or reason is refused loudly at save and at run, and A gives the same verdict in tests as in production. B would let a test pass silently.
④ Start-up stage, no sprawl: no new key family or gate. `reasons` and `params` are optional subkeys of the catalogue ruling A already declared; C costs nothing but leaves the declared capability unreachable from TS.
Prior rulings read: `refusals`, `hook refusal` → 1 hit (6431311681, letter A); ADR-0112 (code spelling); thread: 2 (the dev's 6879027410, 6879045779)

### 推荐与置信缺口

推荐 A + S1 + 参数，一次续派做完。只看①选 A/S1/是；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

- B 不取：测试与生产行为不一致，正是 #24289 修过的那类分歧。
- C 不取：已声明的能力 TS 作者够不着。
- S2 不取：要重裁 A。

盲区：端到端启动未实测（开发容器未做安装和构建），结论均来自读源码并逐行引用。

### 裁后执行

本席同笔把文件面扩展到 `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts` 与 `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`，然后向同一云会话 `session_017xRBcRivaGj55DhDi7sE8w` 续派（同认领、同分支）。PR 开出后由本席在契约复审档位复审。

Related: #26170, #22450 (PR #22525), #24289, #33213 (`domain:server`, not in this order).

Execution:
1. Accept `refusals` on a handler hook (a function or a string ref), judged by a literal-throw reading over the handler source.
2. Answer the catalogue on every path. The lowered body serves it as today; the in-process paths serve it at the `withInProcessHookTitle` seam, with a mark on errors raised out of `ctx.api` so a host-raised refusal passes through unchanged. The wire is identical to the body path.

4. `params`: the entry declares names; a `{{ }}` hole only over a declared param (still refused with none declared); rendered with the flow `end` text-slot renderer; carried across the QuickJS error channel.
